verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature in the Guichet unique itself. The only open-format access is indirect: the INPI-operated registry is free to consult and fully dematerialized, and a separate state company-data API returns registry JSON to keyless requests. That covers public registry data, not the user's own filings and dossiers. The portal is also the mandatory single window for company formalities, so 'leaving' is not really an option. Missing for 10: a first-party export of filings, documents and dashboard data in open formats; documentation of data portability from the Guichet unique itself; any exit path.
